resources.string: Display the current level inside the system volume panel.
Drag in steps of 10; use −/+ for single levels. Reboot to apply.
Drag in steps of 10; use −/+ for single levels. Below this level, volume keys use the low-volume step.
Levels per key press in the fine adjustment range. 1 gives the finest control.
Levels per key press above the fine adjustment range, for faster volume changes.
Snap the volume slider to intervals of this many levels. 1 disables snapping.
Saved. Reboot your phone to apply.
Turn off to restore the stock 29 levels after reboot.
Enabled. Reboot to apply the volume levels.
Disabled. Reboot to restore the stock 29 levels.

Controls media volume (stream types: %1$s). Other streams keep their stock levels.\nStep sizes and snapping apply immediately; changing the level count or enabling/disabling the module requires a reboot.\nBefore disabling the module in LSPosed, turn off the switch above and reboot to restore volume settings first.
